title: MOTD - Changer
description: This plugin allows you to change the motd of your minecraft server!
body:
The MOTD Changer is currently configured to display fun facts about Minecraft, making your server feel more dynamic and entertaining for players. Instead of showing the same static message every time, the MOTD rotates through a collection of Minecraft-related facts at a set interval. This is a great way to keep the server fresh, share interesting trivia, and make the server list experience more engaging for both new and returning players. You can fully customize the messages, adjust how often they change, and reload settings whenever needed.

How to Use

Commands:

/motdchanger help → Get a full list of commands and in-game help.

/motdchanger add → Add a new sentence to the list of rotating MOTDs.

/motdchanger list → View all current MOTDs configured on the server.

/motdchanger interval → Change the time interval for how long it takes the MOTD to 
switch messages.

/motdchanger reload → Reload the plugin and apply changes from the config.yml file.
